channel.title: Service Accounts on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Service Accounts on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Service Account
item.description: This section describes how to create a service account. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Service Account Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Service Account Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Service Accounts in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Service Accounts List
item.description: This section describes how to view the list of service accounts. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Service Accounts View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Service Accounts View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Service Accounts in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Service Account Details
item.description: This section describes how to view service account details. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Service Account View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Service Account View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Service Accounts in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Service Account Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit the information of a service account. You can edit the alias and description of a service account. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a service account. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Service Account Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Service Account Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Modify Service Account Role
item.description: This section describes how to modify service account roles. You can control the permissions of a service account by assigning roles to it, enabling the service account to access specific resources and perform specific operations. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Service Account Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Service Account Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Delete Service Accounts
item.description: This section describes how to delete a service account. Warning After a service account is deleted, applications using the service account will not be able to access the KubeSphere cluster. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Service Account Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles.
